notes.title: Bug fixes and color correction changes
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
1.Main character does not fall under the ground when loading, for landscape loading the main character's gravity becomes zero for 7 seconds.
2.At a quick save appears a notification that the save was successful. 
3.Contrast of colours changed, the picture is brighter and more saturated.
4.Error on the underground bridge fixed when you press E all works. 
5.Corrected nav meshes, now the mobs that did not walk walk.
6.Textures landscape became more detailed. Sand, grass and rocks became more beautiful.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
